name: FLOP-per-byte bounded-tier admission
flip_test: Replay the Mooncake traces for DeepSeek-V3 at a 0.5–1M-token HBM cache and a 10–35% SSD write budget, against two baselines: Marconi-style FLOP/byte eviction and HiCache `write_through_selective`. | If Idea 1 beats both by less than about 10% in saved prefill FLOPs per byte, it falls below "none" and Idea 2 or the plain stock stack leads. If it keeps more than 30% over both, it rises to about 35%.
